title: Promoting the Responsible Development of Speech Datasets for Mental Health and Neurological Disorders Research
reasoning: The paper is centered on evaluating the ethical landscape of speech datasets in mental health research. It establishes a list of ethical 'desiderata' and a 7-point checklist (informed consent, storage/security, privacy, accountability, fairness/bias, etc.) used to systematically evaluate 36 different datasets and papers, making the analysis of research ethics and moral responsibility its core theme.
